segments.ja470:1.1: Neva kiṇāmi napi vikkiṇāmi, na cāpi me sannicayo ca atthi [idhatthi (syā.)];
segments.ja470:1.3: Sukiccharūpaṃ vatidaṃ parittaṃ, patthodano nālamayaṃ duvinnaṃ.
segments.ja470:2.3: Bahumhā bahukaṃ dajjā, adānaṃ nupapajjati [na upapajjati (sī. pī.), nūpapajjati (syā.)].
segments.ja470:3.1: Taṃ taṃ vadāmi kosiya, dehi dānāni bhuñja ca.
segments.ja470:3.3: Ariyamaggaṃ samārūha [ariyaṃ maggaṃ samāruha (sī. pī.)], nekāsī labhate sukhaṃ.
segments.ja470:4.3: Atithismiṃ yo nisinnasmiṃ, eko bhuñjati bhojanaṃ.
segments.ja470:5.1: Taṃ taṃ vadāmi kosiya, dehi dānāni bhuñja ca;
segments.ja470:6.3: Atithismiṃ yo nisinnasmiṃ, neko bhuñjati bhojanaṃ.
segments.ja470:7.1: Taṃ taṃ vadāmi kosiya, dehi dānāni bhuñja ca;
segments.ja470:8.1: Sarañca juhati poso, bahukāya gayāya ca;
segments.ja470:9.1: Atra cassa hutaṃ hoti, atra cassa samīhitaṃ;
segments.ja470:9.3: Atithismiṃ yo nisinnasmiṃ, neko bhuñjati bhojanaṃ.
segments.ja470:10.1: Taṃ taṃ vadāmi kosiya, dehi dānāni bhuñja ca;
segments.ja470:11.1: Baḷisañhi so nigilati [niggilati (sī. pī.)], dīghasuttaṃ sabandhanaṃ;
segments.ja470:11.3: Atithismiṃ yo nisinnasmiṃ, eko bhuñjati bhojanaṃ.
segments.ja470:12.1: Taṃ taṃ vadāmi kosiya, dehi dānāni bhuñja ca;
segments.ja470:13.1: Uḷāravaṇṇā vata brāhmaṇā ime, ayañca vo sunakho kissa hetu;
segments.ja470:13.3: Uccāvacaṃ vaṇṇanibhaṃ vikubbati, akkhātha no brāhmaṇā ke nu tumhe.
segments.ja470:14.1: Cando ca suriyo ca [sūriyo ca (ka.)] ubho idhāgatā, ayaṃ pana mātali devasārathi;
segments.ja470:14.3: Sakkohamasmi tidasānamindo, eso ca kho pañcasikhoti vuccati.
segments.ja470:15.1: Pāṇissarā mudiṅgā ca [mutiṅgā ca (sī. syā. pī.], murajālambarāni ca;
segments.ja470:16.1: Ye kecime maccharino kadariyā, paribhāsakā samaṇabrāhmaṇānaṃ;
segments.ja470:16.3: Idheva nikkhippa sarīradehaṃ, kāyassa bhedā nirayaṃ vajanti.
segments.ja470:17.1: Ye kecime suggatimāsamānā [suggatimāsasānā (sī. pī.), suggatāsisamānā (ka.)], dhamme ṭhitā saṃyame saṃvibhāge;
segments.ja470:17.3: Idheva nikkhippa sarīradehaṃ, kāyassa bhedā sugatiṃ vajanti.
segments.ja470:18.1: Tvaṃ nosi ñāti purimāsu jātisu, so maccharī rosako [kosiyo (syā. ka.)] pāpadhammo;
segments.ja470:18.3: Taveva atthāya idhāgatamhā, mā pāpadhammo nirayaṃ gamittha [appattha (ka. sī. syā. pī.)].
segments.ja470:19.1: Addhā hi maṃ vo hitakāmā, yaṃ maṃ samanusāsatha;
segments.ja470:19.3: Sohaṃ tathā karissāmi, sabbaṃ vuttaṃ hitesibhi.
segments.ja470:20.1: Esāhamajjeva upāramāmi, na cāpihaṃ [na cāpahaṃ (sī. pī.)] kiñci kareyya pāpaṃ;
segments.ja470:20.3: Na cāpi me kiñci adeyyamatthi, na cāpidatvā udakaṃ pivāmi [udakampahaṃ pibe (sī.)].
segments.ja470:21.1: Evañca me dadato sabbakālaṃ [kāle (ka.)], bhogā ime vāsava khīyissanti;
segments.ja470:21.3: Tato ahaṃ pabbajissāmi sakka, hitvāna kāmāni yathodhikānīti.
